component.name: Tretlager
component.summary: Set up Zwift on Linux and connect your sensors
Zwift unter Linux einrichten und mit Sensoren verbinden

description.p: Tretlager sets up the official Zwift Windows client with its own Wine, starts it with one click and connects smart trainers and heart rate straps through a Bluetooth bridge that presents them to Zwift as Wahoo Direct Connect devices.
Tretlager is not affiliated with Zwift Inc. Zwift does not support Linux; use at your own risk.
Not for races: there is no guarantee that the sensor bridge passes power, cadence and heart rate to Zwift correctly. Do not use Tretlager for races or competitions with results.
